text:
Rae: Tiny update — met a new office guest today. Please welcome Pancake, my sugar glider. I left a tiny hammock by the window and she immediately moved in. photo attached :bat: :sparkles:
Marco: Sugar glider??? no way drop the pic pls 
Jen: Awww please be careful with snacks near her, they can be sticky. 
Rae: Yep keeping her in a closed carrier when walking through common areas. She only comes out for supervised window naps. 
Marco: She looks like a stuffed animal come to life. Could we call her the official 'meeting mascot'? 
Rae: Only for quick 1:1s, not for board meetings :smile: 
ops-bot: Reminder: animals must be supervised in common areas. Please avoid bringing animals into meeting rooms without prior approval. 
Jen: Also throwing in a tiny poll — who wants pancake-themed stickers on the whiteboard? 
Marco: Me!  
Rae: I will bring a small pack tomorrow. Also pro tip: sugar gliders love eucalyptus scent — don't use any strong cleaners near the hammock. 
Jen: noted. thanks for the heads up. 
Rae: photo dump incoming in replies. thanks for making her feel welcome :)
